cases.case: plain, non-transforming Saga — final chapter has no self-zone-change effect
cases.note: A mock Saga whose final chapter effect has no self-move. Verified in saga.test.ts via real, repeated advanceSaga calls (a direct function call, not a scripted turn-by-turn trace) genuinely sacrificing the permanent at 714.4.

cases.case: transforming Saga — final chapter resolves a self-referential exile-then-return Sequence
cases.mirrors: Jill, Shiva's Dominant // Shiva, Warden of Ice / Dion, Bahamut's Dominant // Bahamut, Warden of Light
cases.note: A mock Saga whose final chapter's effect is combinator.ts's sequence('Exile', 'Battlefield') (the same real AST shape Jill/Dion's own migrated definitions use). Verified in saga.test.ts via real, repeated advanceSaga calls: the permanent survives on the Battlefield with its lore counters reset (400.7), and 714.4's sacrifice never fires.

cases.case: a transform-shaped Saga (declares its own backFace) whose final chapter does NOT move itself
cases.mirrors: Jecht, Reluctant Guardian // Braska's Final Aeon
cases.note: A mock front/back pair (same shape as the Sequence case above) whose back-face Saga's final chapter has no self-move. Verified in saga.test.ts via real, repeated advanceSaga calls genuinely sacrificing the permanent — proving the predicate checks the chapter's own effects rather than merely 'does this card have a backFace.'
